name: hyper-text
title: Hyper Text
description: A text animation that scrambles letters before revealing the final text.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HyperText } from '@/components/ui/hyper-text'
</script>

<template>
  <HyperText>Hover Me!</HyperText>
</template>

props.name: text
props.description: The text to scramble. Falls back to the text of the default slot.

props.name: duration
props.description: Duration of the scramble in milliseconds.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before the first scramble in milliseconds.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until the element scrolls into view before the first scramble.

props.name: animateOnHover
props.description: Scramble again whenever the pointer enters the element.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Plain text to scramble, used when the `text` prop is not set.
